name: 세레스

sources.title: 님블뉴런 공식 실험체 스킬: 빛에게 바치는 맹세

visual_review: 은백색 머리·푸른 눈·검과 의상을 유지했습니다. 검 세우기·무릎 굽힘·들어올림·서약 지탱·검 내리기 동작이 이어집니다. 공격이 아닌 보호막 누적 효과입니다. 금빛 효과 외곽에 반투명 도트 입자가 많아 어두운 갤러리 배경에서 확인해야 합니다.
motion_summary: Ceres silver-white long hair with dark headpiece, clear cool blue eyes, white-black knightly elegant outfit and gold/white long sword from identity. Official R raises sword while uninterruptibly channeling layered protective shields around herself and allies. Animate poised idle sword diagonally down; hand slides to firm two-handed grip; drawing sword upright before shoulder but never over face; knees bend; lift sword overhead angled toward right; stand tall in solemn vow; warm gold-white light travels up blade; translucent concentric shield rings grow at boots and shoulder sides; taking small stabilizing step with cloak swaying while sword stays raised; sword gradually lowers; gold shields fade; original idle. This is a PROTECTIVE VOW, not an attacking slash. Character must visibly change posture/arms during raise and lower, noble focused face.
